Third-party files in this folder were copied so the page can run without a CDN.

- jQuery 3.7.1, jQuery UI 1.13.2, jQuery UI Touch Punch 0.2.3, jQuery Validation 1.20.0, Moment 2.29.1, Bootbox 5.5.2
- Bootstrap 5.3.3 (`bootstrap.bundle.min.js` includes Popper; the non-bundle build needs a separate Popper which this page does not load)
- Font Awesome Free 6.5.1 (icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT). See the headers in `fontawesome/css/`.
- Lato and Fjalla One, SIL Open Font License 1.1. License texts are `fonts/OFL-Lato.txt` and `fonts/OFL-FjallaOne.txt`.

SRI hashes from the original callingmanager.com page were checked for the CDN copies of jQuery, jQuery UI, Moment, Touch Punch, jQuery Validation, Bootstrap, Bootbox, and Font Awesome CSS before they were saved here. Source-map comments were removed so developer tools do not request map files.
